verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents what happens when a plan's automation or API call limits are exceeded: no rate-limit, throttling, overage-charge, or hard-stop behavior is described. The only related item says Custom Agents have manageable 'credit limits', which shows limits exist but not the consequence of exceeding them. That is an adjacent control, not the capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know what happens—extra charges, throttling, or a hard stop—when I exceed my plan's automation or API call limits
